credits.title: I Built a Rocket Imagining Your Arrival
credits.overview: Fifty-something Rosa, lying in an MRI scanner, is prompted to summon a happy memory. She plunges into a meandering, subconscious road trip with her indomitable mother, both queer, where wild imagination becomes a tender, unruly form of therapy.

credits.title: Heavier Is the Sky
credits.overview: After taking in an abandoned child, Teresa meets Antônio and the two begin a journey on the roads. The common past, for them, is the memories of a city submerged at the bottom of a dam. Life is a dream, but the future is uncertainty.

credits.title: On The Edge
credits.overview: Niara, a police officer about to retire, faces the dichotomies of a corrupt security system alongside the broken human relations around her.

credits.title: O Filho Único do Meu Pai
credits.overview: "O Filho Único do Pai" tells the story of Lucas, a frustrated logistics analyst who tries to pull himself together after being betrayed by his fiancee. credits.title: Aqui Entre Nós
credits.overview: Lucas returns to his parents house to celebrate his father's sixteenth birthday. When confronted with the conservative and bourgeois world from which he had escaped, Lucas realizes that he can no longer hide behind his old mask and decides to express what he really thinks.

credits.title: Greta
credits.overview: Pedro, a 70-year-old gay nurse, is taking care of Daniela, his ailing transgender friend. In order to find her a vacant hospital bed, he decides to help an arrested and wounded criminal to escape.

credits.overview: Isadora returns to her hometown after learning of her father's serious illness. Upon arriving there, she relives the tense relationship she has with her mother amid the most painful family reminiscences.

credits.overview: The film follows the life of the doctor Menezes (Carlos Vereza), known as the doctor of the poor.
